style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight
subject: ONE mara, patagonian cavy, long legged rodent, grey brown, white rump, same animal throughout
second_characters: owl realtors in neckties, crossing the lens
environment: midday steppe, dry grass, low bushes, his burrow mouth, dust
lighting: white daylight from above, hard cyan rim left, warm amber kick right
motion_rule: world flies at the hero: steppe, dust and owls rush into the lens, the mara drives across frame. new shot size every beat. one hero action per beat. he throws his body the full width across frame in every beat, fills half the frame height, muzzle to the lens, medium to close. an owl crosses the lens in every beat.

audio.rate: 3.7 syllables per second, each line fits its beat
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, speech ends by 7.30, then only wind
audio.lip_sync: muzzle to the lens, jaw opens on every syllable, mouth empty while speaking, nothing in the mouth before 7.85
audio.pronunciation: MA-ry, RO-yem, vle-ZA-yem, dol-go-VO-ye, be-TON, za-BUD-te

timeline.a: ploughs the soil at a run left to right across the full width, clods flying back; an owl at the lens takes clods and squats
wheels and ploughs back across frame, a fan of earth sprays past the lens; an owl sinks into the soil up to its tie
charges the full length of frame, muzzle up to the lens; a second owl plants a lone door frame upright in the empty steppe ahead
hurls his body sideways through the empty opening, the frame bursts into laths; an owl clings to the laths and is dragged to the lens
rolls out of the gap into a new run across frame; two owls unroll a bristle mat across his path, bowing
hooks the mat edge with a hind paw and drags it across the whole frame; both owls tumble into the lens
swats the key aside with a forepaw without slowing; an owl flings it on a wing, the key flies into the lens
brakes sideways, skids the full width, earth crest under his paws, stops at his burrow mouth; an owl rises from the mound with the tie
throws his body across frame and the owl loops the tie over his neck on the move; he shakes it straight at the lens
rolls a concrete block across his own burrow mouth like a turnstile and swings his body past it; an owl stops dead at the block
shoots a paw open at the lens; an owl drops a block into it, the paw sags, he pumps the block once, the recoil turns shoulder and muzzle into the lens, tie askew as the owl dives out

must_appear: furrow and earth tail under his paws at 0.00 and 1.35; a tie in an earth mound at the lens; bare frame upright, then laths; two owls tumbling into the lens; the key into the lens; the sideways skid full width at 7.30; tie on his neck at 7.85; block across the burrow mouth and his body across it; another block in the sagging paw, muzzle in the lens, tie askew at 9.25
negative_prompt: printed words, digits, Cyrillic or Latin, a door leaf, a house, a building, night, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, speech bubble, horizontal frame, black bars, speech after 7.30, English speech, foreign accent, extra limbs, two maras, wide shot, view from behind, lowered head during speech, parked camera, push in, motionless background, hero riding anything, human hands
